SELECT 
    effectivenessrobot,
    (safety_metrics->>'overloads')::int + 
    (safety_metrics->>'collisions')::int + 
    (safety_metrics->>'emergency_stops')::int + 
    (safety_metrics->>'speed_violations')::int AS sis
FROM performance_and_safety 
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    ps.effectivenessrobot,
    COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'overloads')::int, 0) + 
    COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'collisions')::int, 0) + 
    COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'emergency_stops')::int, 0) + 
    COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'speed_violations')::int, 0) AS sis
FROM performance_and_safety ps
WHERE ps.effectivenessrobot = 'RF806459';

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sis > 20) as high_concern,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sis <= 20 AND sis IS NOT NULL) as normal
FROM (
    SELECT 
        ps.effectivenessrobot,
        COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'overloads')::int, 0) + 
        COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'collisions')::int, 0) + 
        COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'emergency_stops')::int, 0) + 
        COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'speed_violations')::int, 0) AS sis
    FROM performance_and_safety ps
) sub;

SELECT 
    rd.bottypeval AS robot_type,
    AVG(
        COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'overloads')::int, 0) + 
        COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'collisions')::int, 0) + 
        COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'emergency_stops')::int, 0) + 
        COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'speed_violations')::int, 0)
    ) AS avg_sis,
    MAX(
        COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'overloads')::int, 0) + 
        COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'collisions')::int, 0) + 
        COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'emergency_stops')::int, 0) + 
        COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'speed_violations')::int, 0)
    ) AS max_sis
FROM performance_and_safety ps
JOIN robot_details rd ON ps.effectivenessrobot = rd.botdetreg
WHERE COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'overloads')::int, 0) + 
      COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'collisions')::int, 0) + 
      COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'emergency_stops')::int, 0) + 
      COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'speed_violations')::int, 0) > 20
GROUP BY rd.bottypeval
ORDER BY avg_sis DESC;

SELECT 
    rd.bottypeval AS robot_type,
    ROUND(
        AVG(
            COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'overloads')::int, 0) + 
            COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'collisions')::int, 0) + 
            COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'emergency_stops')::int, 0) + 
            COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'speed_violations')::int, 0)
        )::numeric, 2
    ) AS avg_sis,
    MAX(
        COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'overloads')::int, 0) + 
        COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'collisions')::int, 0) + 
        COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'emergency_stops')::int, 0) + 
        COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'speed_violations')::int, 0)
    ) AS max_sis
FROM performance_and_safety ps
JOIN robot_details rd ON ps.effectivenessrobot = rd.botdetreg
WHERE COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'overloads')::int, 0) + 
      COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'collisions')::int, 0) + 
      COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'emergency_stops')::int, 0) + 
      COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'speed_violations')::int, 0) > 20
GROUP BY rd.bottypeval
ORDER BY avg_sis DESC;

SELECT 
    rd.bottypeval AS robot_type,
    COUNT(*) AS high_concern_count,
    AVG(o.totopshrval) AS avg_toh
FROM performance_and_safety ps
JOIN robot_details rd ON ps.effectivenessrobot = rd.botdetreg
JOIN operation o ON o.operbotdetref = rd.botdetreg
WHERE COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'overloads')::int, 0) + 
      COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'collisions')::int, 0) + 
      COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'emergency_stops')::int, 0) + 
      COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'speed_violations')::int, 0) > 20
GROUP BY rd.bottypeval
ORDER BY high_concern_count DESC;

SELECT 
    rd.bottypeval AS robot_type,
    COUNT(*) AS high_concern_count,
    ROUND(AVG(o.totopshrval)::numeric, 2) AS avg_toh
FROM performance_and_safety ps
JOIN robot_details rd ON ps.effectivenessrobot = rd.botdetreg
JOIN operation o ON o.operbotdetref = rd.botdetreg
WHERE COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'overloads')::int, 0) + 
      COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'collisions')::int, 0) + 
      COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'emergency_stops')::int, 0) + 
      COALESCE((ps.safety_metrics->>'speed_violations')::int, 0) > 20
GROUP BY rd.bottypeval
ORDER BY high_concern_count DESC;
